title: the record gets a top-level navigation and, at last, a version of its own
summary: Four navigation groups across the top — Building it, Identities, The agent, Still open — so a reader arrives at an altitude rather than at the top of a thirteen-section scroll. The version number joins the masthead and links to its own entry. Adds the versions/ directory the sgit.ai guidance has required since before this vault existed and which both agents who worked on it missed.
